# FileEntry

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Read-only filebase snapshot: name, description, 64-bit byte size and UTC date. Available from runtime 400.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#filebase-search-400).

## Date

`FileEntry.Date: DATE`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only snapshot. Id is the filebase cursor, Size is LONG bytes, Date is a native calendar DATE in UTC and Timestamp is a UTC TIMESTAMP. Description is limited to 16384 UTF-8 bytes; DescriptionTruncated reports clipping. Search examines only this prefix. An uninitialized entry has Valid=FALSE and empty/zero fields; its temporal fields are empty.

## Timestamp

`FileEntry.Timestamp: TIMESTAMP`

Read-only instance property.

Native UTC timestamp, retaining the precision of the backing data. Writable user expiry fields reject empty values. Invalid objects return empty.
